stem: A seed lot shows strong radicle emergence, but many seedlings fail after transfer into a saturated medium. Which interpretation best separates the stages of failure?
choices: Initial viability may be acceptable while establishment is failing because later root-zone conditions are unsuitable
The seed lot must be nonviable because any later seedling loss proves germination failed
Radicle emergence and seedling establishment are the same outcome and should not be tracked separately
The only useful metric is the final number of seeds that were started
rationale: Radicle emergence, surface emergence, and establishment are distinct milestones. Strong germination followed by losses after transfer points to a later establishment problem rather than proving poor initial viability.
